Class Type

java.lang.Object
threepl.exec.Type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constant
public class Type extends Object implements Constant
This class represents variable types. There are 4 entities that are represented -
  • a primitive type
  • one dimension of an array
  • a struct
  • an enumerated type

A primitive type has an integer code in prim_type. If the primitive type is a pointer, prim_type will have the value typePTR.

An array has the dimension in dim. array_type points to the array Type. For multi-dimensioned arrays the Type pointed to will itself be an array.

A struct has field identifiers mapped to Fields through field_map. field_index locates Fields by position index. a Field contains both the field name and its Type. Using both a map indexed by field identifier and a list indexed by field position allows structs to be mapped in the order of occurence of the fields in the source code.

.An enum has the value identifiers mapped to associated ordinals via the paired lists enum_ids and enum_ords.

    • Type

      public Type(String spec, SrcLoc loc)
      Construct a type from a type specification string. Arrays and structs are built up by recursive calls to this constructor. A type string such as "int" will result in construction of a primitive type. "[2][3]int" will produce two array Types and a primitive type linked together. "[3]st", where st has been declared as a struct, will produce an array type and a struct type.
      Parameters:
      spec - is the string specifying the type
      loc - is the source file location

    • Type

      public Type(String spec, boolean isparam, boolean isarg, SrcLoc loc)
      Construct a type from a type specification string. Arrays and structs are built up by recursive calls to this constructor. A type string such as "int" will result in construction of a primitive type. "[2][3]int" will produce two array Types and a primitive type linked together. "[3]st", where st has been declared as a struct, will produce wo array Types and a struct type.
      Parameters:
      spec - is the string specifying the type
      isparam - is true if this type is for a module, procedure or function parameter
      isarg - is true if this type is a module, procedure or function argument string
      loc - is the source file location

    • resolveWidths

      public void resolveWidths(Object[] values, SrcLoc loc)
      Add primitive type widths to a type. This is used where a parameter has been created with missing primitive widths and these widths are to be determined from the passed argument.
      Parameters:
      values - is an array of constants which is used to determine primitive type widths
      loc - is the source file location

    • matchArray

      public void matchArray(int[] dimdes, int index, Type ct, String mess, SrcLoc loc)
      For a parameter which has one or more missing array dimensions check or supply missing dimensions from the dimensional description provided (dimdes). Check correct dimensionality as this proceeds. If a check type is supplied, check the final type. If the final type is a primitive type with missing width and a check type is supplied, correct the width. This method is called recursively for each dimension.
      Parameters:
      dimdes - is the array dimensionality - if null an exception is thrown
      index - is the index into dimdes to match this the current Type
      ct - is the optional argument check type (primitive or struct)
      mess - is a fatal message to be printed if types do not match
      loc - is the source file location

    • isEqual

      public boolean isEqual(Type t, boolean strict)
      Compare two types for equality. Structs are compared field by field, so structs with identical fields are considered equal. Types 'int' and 'uint' are considered equal. Widths are not checked since operands of different widths can be assigned, added etc. Arithmetic operators (ExprNode.execute()) do not use this method and check their operands explicitly. Assignment operations (both explicit and parameter/argument assignment) check their operands for an 'int'/'uint' mismatch and implicitly cast where necessary.
      Parameters:
      t - is the Type to be compared with this Type
      strict - is true if target primitive widths are to be checked
      Returns:
      true if the Types are equal

    • numBits

      public int numBits()
      Get the total number of bits for a Type. This is used for target variable assignment. The number of bits for an immediate primitive Type is determined from the type itself and is 64 for typeINT, 63 for typeUINT and 1 for typeLOG (Ptype.STR cannot be assigned to a target variable so the concept of the number of bits is not applicable). The number of bits for a target primitive Type is given by its width field.
      Returns:
      the number of bits

    • numWords

      public int numWords()
      Get the total number of words for a type. A word is a primitive Type.
      Returns:
      the number of words

    • getWordSpec

      public WordSpec getWordSpec(Var var, SubFieldList sfl, SrcLoc loc)
      Get the word specification for a type. The parameter spec is a SubFieldList specifying subscripts or fields for a variable reference in the code tree. The length of 'spec' must match the depth of the type. The returned WordSpec contains bit ranges. Each bit range gives the lower and upper offsets of a word field.
      Parameters:
      var - is the associated variable or null
      sfl - is a list of subscripts and fields or null
      loc - is the source file location
      Returns:
      the word specification

      public WordSpec getWordSpec(Var var, SrcLoc loc)
